description: This file contains platform-specific upgrade scripts for devices using the IXP4XX architecture in the OpenWrt project. It defines functions to check image compatibility and perform upgrades based on the device board name.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the current device's board supports upgrading by verifying the board name.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process for supported boards, specifically handling the 'netgear,wg302v1' model.
